body:
## Summary
Release binary provenance does not identify the tagged source. For v1.16.1, `gh attestation verify link-assistant-router-1.16.1-darwin-arm64.tar.gz --repo link-assistant/router` passes, but:

```
--source-ref refs/tags/v1.16.1  -> Error: expected SourceRepositoryRef to be refs/tags/v1.16.1, got refs/heads/main
--source-digest <commit of tag v1.16.1 = e0cb889c5>  -> fails
attested sourceRepositoryDigest = 2857d57f5 (Merge pull request #690)
```

The tag commit `e0cb889c5 chore: release v1.16.1` is one commit *after* the attested commit. It changes `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, `CHANGELOG.md` and removes a changelog fragment. So the binary that reports `router 1.16.1` is attested as built from a tree whose `Cargo.toml` still has the previous version. Either the build used an uncommitted version bump, or the attestation names the wrong commit. In both cases a user cannot verify that the published binary was built from the tagged source. This is the same class of defect as #191 (images), now for binaries.

## Expected
- Build release binaries and images from the exact tag commit (check out `refs/tags/vX.Y.Z`), so that `sourceRepositoryRef`/`sourceRepositoryDigest` identify the tag. Alternatively, create the release commit and tag *before* the build job and build from it.
- Document the verification command in the README:

  ```
  gh attestation verify <asset> --repo link-assistant/router --source-ref refs/tags/vX.Y.Z
  ```

  Add a CI step that runs exactly that command against every published asset and the container image before the release is promoted from pre-release (the gate from #687).
- Embed the source commit in `router --version --verbose` (or `router version --json`), so a running binary can be matched to its tag.

## Acceptance
- For the next release, verification with `--source-ref refs/tags/<tag>` succeeds for every binary and both image architectures, and the CI gate enforces it.
title: Release binaries are attested from the pre-release merge commit, not the tag: --source-ref refs/tags/vX fails, Cargo.toml version differs
